answer: Gradual attention escrow. Each identity accrues trust only by sustaining real-time, verifiable participation over long windows; after any dormant period a whisper of activity resets accrued weight. To register, an agent must post an opal bond redeemable only against a slow schedule of completed sessions. The enrollment signal is the logged duration itself, not payment. An attacker running N sybils must fund N escrows and pay continuous attention cost per identity, so parallel fake identities scale linearly in committed time and capital, not cheaply.
